title: nominationResponseData
description: Nomination response context containing the location, response period, hourly granularity, unit, internal account and account-specific response time series.

period.description: Period covered by the nomination response data, represented as an ISO 8601 interval or duration expression.

granularity.description: Duration of each nomination response interval. PT1H represents one hour.

unit.description: Unit of the nomination response quantities.

internalAccount.description: Internal balancing group identifier to which the nomination response applies.

nominationResponses.description: Nomination response data for one or more external accounts or matching counterparts.
